package.title: Project Cedar Pilot Overview
package.script:
Project Cedar is currently operating as a pilot program rather than a general launch. The owner, Omar Reed, has confirmed that 18 sensors are scheduled to ship on December 3, 2026. The total budget allocated for this initiative is USD 960. Regarding customer protection, refunds are available within 30 days but strictly for unopened items. Please note: the project documentation does not specify a delivery guarantee or a revenue forecast.

Source details: Customer refunds are available within 30 days only for unopened items.
image_prompts: A minimalist flat lay showing a stack of 18 identical small rectangular sensors arranged neatly on a neutral surface, with a subtle date stamp overlay indicating December 2026.
An abstract digital illustration featuring a budget circle graph labeled 'USD 960' next to a timeline arrow pointing to late 2026, set against a clean white background.
A close-up conceptual shot of a single sensor device resting on a protective foam pad, symbolizing the 'unopened items' condition for refunds, with soft studio lighting.
An infographic style graphic displaying the text 'Pilot Program' prominently above a small icon representing 18 units, avoiding any depiction of live shipping or crowds.
